name: EPIC-KITCHENS-55
summary: EPIC-KITCHENS 的首个大规模版本，记录参与者在自家厨房中的连续第一人称活动，包含动作分段、动词、名词和叙述标注。
summaryEn: The first large EPIC-KITCHENS release, capturing continuous first-person activities in participants' own kitchens with action, verb, noun, and narration labels.
scaleZh: 55 小时 · 32 名参与者 · 39,596 个动作片段
organizations: University of Bristol and University of Catania
organizationsZh: 布里斯托大学、卡塔尼亚大学
license: EPIC-KITCHENS data license; research-use conditions apply
licenseZh: 适用 EPIC-KITCHENS 数据许可及研究用途条件
verdict: 第一人称厨房动态先驱
wmNote: 连续行为和物体标注适合预测，但已被 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 扩展；保留它主要用于复现实验。
wmNoteEn: Continuous behavior supports forecasting, although the 100-hour release supersedes it for new training.
